members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The range as start and end YYYY-MM-DD strings, when the caller controls it. null keeps a controlled field empty. A range missing either end throws a TypeError, and one whose end is before its start is kept as given and is invalid.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting range, when the field controls itself, as a complete pair of YYYY-MM-DD strings.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new range as YYYY-MM-DD strings, or with null when the field is cleared.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the new open state when the calendar opens or closes.

members.name: minValue
members.doc: The earliest date, inclusive. A date before it stays visible and invalid. A minValue later than maxValue throws a TypeError.

members.name: maxValue
members.doc: The latest date, inclusive. A date after it stays visible and invalid.

members.name: unavailableDateMatcher
members.doc: Returns true for a date that cannot be chosen. It receives the date being checked and the anchor, the start date chosen so far or null before a start is chosen, both as YYYY-MM-DD strings. Selection stays contiguous, so a range cannot cross an unavailable date.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the calendar is open, when the caller controls it. It is independent of the range: controlling one does not control the other.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the calendar starts open, when the picker controls itself. Omitted, it starts closed unless a React Aria context supplies defaultOpen.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its range stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: startName
members.doc: The form field name of the start date. It submits YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string while the range is empty.

members.name: endName
members.doc: The form field name of the end date. It submits YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string while the range is empty.
